title: Hydraulic Power — Green System Engine Driven Pump — Case Drain Filter Installation
abstract: Installation of a full-flow case drain filter with a differential pressure indicator on the green system engine driven pump, so that a pump failure stays a pump failure instead of contaminating the whole circuit.

sections.planning_reason: Eight green system engine driven pumps failed at two operators between 2018 and 2019, in every case releasing bearing debris into the return line. Because the original case drain path has no filter, the debris reached the reservoir and from there the whole green circuit, so each event required a system flush and the replacement of every filter and accumulator downstream. Average recovery cost was 190 kEUR per event and one aircraft was out of service for nine days. Root cause was a bearing batch, but the investigation concluded that the missing case drain filtration is what turned a component failure into a system event.
sections.description: A full-flow filter with a differential pressure indicator is installed in the case drain line between the pump and the reservoir return. The non-return valve kit is relocated downstream of the filter, the obsolete forward regulator is removed from the circuit, and the inboard pipe is replaced by a longer run to reach the new filter position. The depressurisation solenoid is replaced by a unit with a positive detent and the actuator is re-shimmed to suit.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Depressurise the green system and lock out the reservoir. WARNING: HYDRAULIC FLUID UNDER PRESSURE CAN CAUSE INJECTION INJURY. CONFIRM ZERO PRESSURE AT THE GAUGE BEFORE ANY JOINT IS OPENED. Open the pylon fairings and get access in zones 433 and 443, and in the main gear bay in zone 721. Do AMM-S-29-10-11-000-014-A to remove the engine driven pump. Remove the forward regulator D2910119046146 from the circuit and cap the port. Install the case drain filter on the new bracket and relocate the non-return valve kit D2910110297925 downstream of it. Install the longer inboard pipe FJO107150-27 and support it with two additional loop clamps AGS207234-50. Replace the left-hand depressurisation solenoid BE759984-33 and re-shim the right-hand actuator DU841059-74 to the dimension in the accomplishment instructions. Re-secure the left-hand clamp position 9247GG to the revised bracket. Do AMM-S-29-10-11-400-014-A to install the pump. Fill, bleed and pressurise the green system and check the differential pressure indicator reads clear. Do a leak check at operating pressure and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to the eight aircraft listed in the effectivity, which are the aircraft of the two operators affected by the original event. Other operators may request an extension of effectivity through their customer support focal; the change is technically applicable to any twin-engine aircraft at the original case drain standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K2910-1018-01 contains the filter, the bracket, the longer pipe, the clamps and the fastener set. The depressurisation solenoid is a separately ordered rotable exchange and is not in the kit. Lead time is sixteen weeks for the kit and eight weeks for the solenoid exchange.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
